source.bindingRule: At publication, bind the exact product commit and rebuilt WASM/manifest identities to this frozen C source and patch. A different C source is not qualified by this registration.

criterionSource: Root accepted prospective negative-control review before generation or timing.
scope: One independent hosted fail-fast risk screen of complete sequential inflate + CRC + strict parse + completed lookup construction; no full-import or equivalence claim.

topology.grouping: Both compressed banks form one fused source group

measurement.pairedUnit: The sum of all 16 measured enclosing-component elapsed times from one child
measurement.timedWork: Fresh native inflate and per-bank CRC, strict grammar parse, and completed lookup indexes on every repetition
measurement.digestPlacement: After every pass clock stops, before any subsequent parse can overwrite WASM-backed views

cases.purpose: Moved key-comparison and flag overhead without selector admission
cases.shape: Unique short expression keys; empty reading alias or unique independent readings; unique equal-length common-prefix approximately 240-byte text glossaries
assertions: Raw keys stay within the current 32-byte key-body comparison bound
No shared independent reading can admit the selector
Zero new selector admissions and zero reuse hits

cases.purpose: Repeated admitted short-glossary full comparison misses
cases.shape: One short key and one header family; unique equal-length approximately 240-byte text glossaries
assertions: Every non-first row has baseline lookback zero
Exact 8-byte tail and middle samples match
Six-digit global counter lies outside both sample windows at a fixed late raw offset
Full equality rejects; zero reuse hits

cases.purpose: Older long candidate admitted after a short previous glossary
cases.shape: One short key; alternating different prefix-header families and short/4096-byte glossary families; all unique
assertions: Header families differ within their first four raw token bytes, not merely later
Long-after-short rows select an older raw glossary of at least 512 bytes
Tail and middle samples pass; full equality rejects at a late unsampled difference
Old long-previous probes are counted separately from new selector-origin probes

fixtureInvariants: Use a six-digit global row ID across both banks; do not reset uniqueness at the bank boundary
Fix serialized raw glossary lengths within each family and report exact lengths including delimiters
Record mutation offsets and exact sample windows in the generator manifest
Use valid strict format-3 eight-field rows, integer scores and supported sequence values
Bind generator source, raw bank bytes, compressed bank bytes, compressed/uncompressed lengths, and CRCs with hashes
Freeze compression settings and generated inputs before acquisition; no adaptive selection

required: prefix records inspected and selected distance
new-selector full misses and bytes offered
unchanged adaptive probe budget and match streak
separateMechanics.comparison: Mechanics artifact uses the same frozen fixture/source and is separate from all timing observations

rejection.metric: Median paired change of enclosing-component elapsed child sums
rejection.controlRule: Candidate median paired slowdown exceeds the largest absolute identical-code C/D paired change in that same case
rejection.consequence: Clear qualifying negative slowdown holds or rejects this exact candidate, with no adaptive cap/admission retuning
rejection.ambiguousPolicy: Ambiguous negative controls remain a hold or qualification limitation, not an automatic pass
rejection.limit: Passing this one-host screen does not establish equivalence or nonregression

preservation: Preserve every raw repetition, child, control, outlier, semantic failure, source/fixture/toolchain receipt, and incomplete acquisition. No retries or result-directed replacement.
reviewLimit: The alternating two-family case exercises an older selection at distance 2. The four-row window is bounded in source; this is not exhaustive coverage of every prefix-admission pattern.
